articles.title: U.S. Hits Bonkers Measles High as RFK Jr.’s CDC Hides Death Totals
articles.dek: The U.S. is on the cusp of losing its measles elimination status. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention confirmed 5,182 measles infections nationwide Friday, the highest case load of the disease that the country has experienced since 1991.
